newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares off at noon on Hong Kong holiday.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares off at noon on Hong Kong holiday.

text.p: Shanghai's foreign currency B shares fell 2.70 percent in morning trade on Monday as a holiday in Hong Kong cut off a major source of funds that has recently propelled the B index higher, brokers said.
B shares soared on Thursday and Friday after foreign and Hong Kong money poured into the market, encouraging local investors to join the buying frenzy, they said.
The B index ended the morning down 2.371 points to 85.305 on turnover of $12.002 million against $43.036 million on Friday morning.
The A index shed 16.972 points or 1.43 percent to 1,171.852 on turnover of 1.255 billion yuan against 1.325 billion the previous morning session.
The SSE30 blue chip index lost 43.230 points or 1.21 percent to 3,536.680.
Xiamen Longzhou Co was the worst A share performer, tumbliing 1.05 yuan or 9.50 percent to 10.00 yuan.
Both the A and B share markets were likely to remain weak in the afternoon but the outlook for the B share index remained positive in the near term, brokers said.
